answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 124 identities means 124 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the quill pair is tracked in the violet ledger, the quartz audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward requires answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 34%. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
